profile_text.body:
Jasper is a for-profit startup founded in 2021 and headquartered in Austin, Texas, that builds AI tools aimed at marketing teams. The company describes its products as spanning advanced language models, context-aware intelligence, and intuitive agents, and positions its platform around helping marketers customize AI for their own workflows.

Jasper's tracked products include Jasper for marketing copy, Jasper Campaigns for end-to-end cross-channel campaign creation with a brand voice and governance dashboard, and Jasper Art for marketing image generation and brand asset creation with commercial use rights. Its site promotes a feature called Image Pipelines, which the company describes as capable of generating on-brand product imagery at ten times the speed and up to 50 percent lower cost compared to conventional approaches.

The site's held facts associate Jasper with 82 legal matters in Texas, though no specific cases are detailed in the available data.
